identity.adjudicator: independent non-author reviewer after four blind envelopes exist
identity.statement: Verify exact algebra for the authenticated restricted RW relaxation branch, a stipulated near-FLRW two-fluid drag stability lemma, the registered persistent-mode negative control, and the exact domain mapping of a separately authenticated Bianchi-VIII source counterexample. CAS does not prove the external asymptotic theorem or physical source-space closure.

independence.correlation_disclosure: One main writer prepared the axis sources; executions and result visibility are isolated. This is four-axis formal cross-checking, not four independent physical derivations.
independence.result_visibility: No axis may read a sibling result before all four assignments close and adjudication begins.

changes: construct the SymPy characteristic polynomial from det(rI-A) to avoid same-name symbol identity drift
use mapping-form Sage substitution everywhere and coerce Sage booleans and precision to JSON-native values
normalize the Lean characteristic identity with ring and correct the registered negative sign fixture
revision.engineering_preflight: SymPy, Sage/Singular, and Lean sources each completed locally after the repairs; these preflights are tool-readiness evidence only and are not axis results.
revision.reason: Generation 2 exposed three additional representation and proof-script defects; no generation-2 result is reused.

assumptions: flat RW source branch: constant -1<w<1/3, homogeneous non-interacting perfect fluid, N=ln(a), abs(v)<1
drag lemma: a=1-3w_X>0, x>=0, y>=0, aligned first-order tilts, no persistent source, stipulated momentum-conserving closure
counterexample mapping: gamma=1+w=5/4, w=1/4, Gamma=0, positive gamma-law density in the primary-source Bianchi-VIII class
the external late-time extreme-tilt theorem is authenticated by provenance and is not synthesized by CAS
semantics.exact_statement: The frozen RW logarithmic invariant differentiates to 3w-1; the stipulated drag matrix has trace -(a+x+y+1) and determinant a(1+y)+x, hence is Hurwitz for a>0,x,y>=0; the generic matrix [[-1,1],[1,-1]] has a zero persistent mode; gamma=5/4 maps to w=1/4<1/3 and Gamma=0>=0.
exclusions: no generic interacting-fluid or nonlinear shear closure
no proof of the external Bianchi-VIII asymptotic theorem by CAS
no isotropy, observational, transfer, posterior, evidence, detection, geometry, or family-identification claim

symbol_type_domain_map.Gamma: phenomenological interaction rate; zero in the source counterexample
symbol_type_domain_map.N: future-oriented ln(a) only on the flat-RW branch
symbol_type_domain_map.V,tau,S: external Bianchi-VIII source symbols not equated to RW variables
symbol_type_domain_map.suppression: nullable until duration, initial data, closure and observable map are identified
symbol_type_domain_map.v,w,a,x,y,r: exact rationals for algebraic obligations; inequalities use the frozen ordered domain

target.approximation_order: exact homogeneous RW equation plus first-order stipulated drag subsystem
target.canonical_form: exact rational strings and Boolean obligations; 80-digit replay is a non-authoritative conditioning check
target.equivalence_relation: exact equality under one frozen convention and domain contract

Do not call the stipulated drag matrix a universal interacting-fluid equation.
Do not use the local linear lemma as a nonlinear or global relaxation proof.
Do not let CAS agreement replace external source authentication or physical source-space closure.
Do not preserve the blanket no-go after the registered published counterexample gate passes.
